description: Variation of condition 3 (approved plans) to allow the widening of the approved enlarged dormer of planning permission 00248/474/P6 approved 02/04/2019 for the erection of rear extensions to both flats at first and second floor levels together with a rear roof extension.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Drawings L.01 (Location Plan), TP.08(F), TP.09(E), TP.11(F) and TP.12(D), Flood Risk Assessment documents and Design and Access Statement [received 18/11/2019]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - 3.	The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extensions hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building (brickwork for the two-storey rear extension; tiles for the rear dormer).

Condition : 4 - 4.	No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
